pictures.author: Gryffindor
pictures.observed: Long rough stone wall with brick arch rings, small recessed upper perforated windows, rectangular lower openings and pale circular chimney shafts with dark rims.

pictures.author: Gryffindor
pictures.observed: Open service court between two ranges. High stone kitchens on right, low opposite stone doorway range beneath eaves on left; lead dome on north connecting building, chimney row, upper arched perforated windows and lower door recesses.

pictures.author: Gryffindor
pictures.observed: Stitched broad court frontage: pale slender shafts and capitals, pointed open arches, low continuous lead canopy and brick rear wall. Taller kitchen chimneys and cooking roofs visible behind it. Exact optical dimensions/bay counts are approximate.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific Palace Kitchens range on OSM way32396096: long stone kitchen hall, ten approximate cooking roof bays with lead domes and tall pale open-topped chimneys, recessed arched upper screens and lower doors, northern connecting range and west courtyard range with brick rear wall and a genuinely open pale-column arcade. Preserve the long unroofed service court and all separate palace members. Original medium-fi interpretation; no furnished kitchens, copied inscriptions, people, trees, pots or museum cases.
